scope: Mathematical recomputation of evaluate(assumptions), independent FCFF arithmetic and valuation-related numerical claims in the inspected draft. This is not certification, investment advice, source authentication or verification of forecast plausibility.

draft_numeric_claim_checks.name: capex_share_of_revenue_percent
draft_numeric_claim_checks.anchor: Capital intensity is low relative to revenue

limitations: Rounding checks use the reported display precision.
Only valuation-related and selected historical arithmetic claims are covered; cited source truth and qualitative investment judgments are not certified.
Reverse-DCF root coverage is limited to the engine search procedure; a reported root is checked against the market price, not asserted globally unique.

refresh_provenance.method: Recomputed evaluate() for final files; preserved independent arithmetic checks only after matching input/output/engine bytes; rechecked all draft-number anchors and tokens against the final body.

final_live_review.memo_manifest_hash_basis: UTF-8 bytes of state.current_memo + newline + valuation_section(assumptions, valuation). This is the exact submitted review text, distinct from raw body and rendered memo.md.
